The '''Jundland Safehouse''' was a [[Moisture farm/Legends|moisture farm]] in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. During the [[Third Galactic War]], the farm was used as a safehouse by [[Jemala Ha'rangir]] and [[Ora Nem]] after they escaped the [[Hidden Chain]].<ref name="TOR:OTR" />
